answer: Answer ante: every submission locks 2 POA, sealed like a walnut in its shell until a beacon-drawn panel of 3 graders scores it. Median 2+ cracks it open: ante back plus pay. Median 0-1 burns it. Spam stops being a free lottery ticket and becomes a crystal-clear loss. Assumptions: honest essays pass ~85%, so an honest key burns ~0.3 POA/epoch expected; templated filler passes ~10%, so a 1,000-clone farm burns ~1,800 POA every epoch. The ante cuts the bridge between key count and income: only quality pays.
